correctness.rationale: A has monomial basis x^iy^j (0<=i,j<=2), dim 9, and m has exactly q^8 elements. Nilpotent Jordan type is recovered from r_t=rank(M_{u^t}) via successive differences. For nonzero linear part (a,b), r1=6 and powers through u4 give the p=2, p=3, and p>=5 partitions. For zero linear but nonzero quadratic part (c,d,e), r1=3 iff d²-ce=0 and r2=0 iff d²+2ce=0; each conic has q² points, with intersection 2q-1 except when p=3 where they coincide. The q³ unconstrained higher coefficients and the high-degree tail yield all tabulated multiplicities; the polynomial totals are q^8. Independent direct 9x9 multiplication-matrix ranks exhausted all 256 elements over F2 and all 6561 over F3 with exact agreement (ten and six types respectively). This finite verification corroborates but does not replace the stated all-prime-power algebraic proof.
